description: Land Acquisition - Bambaragama, Atala, Jayamalpura & Epalathotuwa, Galigamuwa D/S Division,  Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (with lot numbers, extents, and boundary information) being acquired for public purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land matters, including property descriptions, boundaries, and acquisition procedures, without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
